definition: A push or pull that can change motion.

examples.en: The teacher explained the term force.
examples.sk: Učiteľ vysvetlil pojem sila.

examples.en: The experiment measured how force changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa sila mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: Four fundamental forces govern the universe: gravity, electromagnetism, and the strong and weak nuclear forces.
The unit of force in the International System of Units is the newton, named after Isaac Newton.

definition: The amount of matter in an object.

examples.en: The teacher explained the term mass.
examples.sk: Učiteľ vysvetlil pojem hmotnosť.

examples.en: The experiment measured how mass changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa hmotnosť mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: Mass is a scalar quantity measured in kilograms and remains constant regardless of location.
Einstein's famous equation E = mc² shows that mass is a concentrated form of energy.

definition: The speed of something in a particular direction.

examples.en: The velocity is important in this field.
examples.sk: Rýchlosť je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

examples.en: The experiment measured how velocity changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa rýchlosť mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: Nothing in the universe can travel faster than the velocity of light in a vacuum.
The velocity of sound in air at 20 °C is approximately 343 metres per second.

definition: The rate at which velocity changes over time.

examples.en: The teacher explained the term acceleration.
examples.sk: Učiteľ vysvetlil pojem zrýchlenie.

examples.en: The experiment measured how acceleration changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa zrýchlenie mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: At the LHC, particles are brought to nearly the speed of light through rapid acceleration.
A free-falling object in a vacuum provides a perfect example of uniform acceleration.

definition: The quantity of motion of a moving body.

examples.en: We studied the concept of momentum yesterday.
examples.sk: Včera sme študovali pojem hybnosť.

examples.en: The experiment measured how momentum changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa hybnosť mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: The law of conservation of momentum states that the total momentum of a closed system remains constant.
In a collision, momentum is transferred from one object to another.

definition: The force that resists motion between surfaces.

examples.en: We studied the concept of friction yesterday.
examples.sk: Včera sme študovali pojem trenie.

examples.en: The experiment measured how friction changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa trenie mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: Without friction, it would be impossible to walk because your feet would slip on the ground.
Rolling friction is generally lower than sliding friction, which is why wheels are so efficient.

definition: A disturbance that transfers energy through space or matter.

examples.en: The wave is important in this field.
examples.sk: Vlna je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

examples.en: The experiment measured how wave changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa vlna mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: Light is an electromagnetic wave and does not need a medium to travel through.
The double-slit experiment produced a classic interference pattern, proving the wave nature of light.

definition: The number of repeated events in a given time.

examples.en: This experiment shows how frequency works.
examples.sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje frekvencia.

examples.en: The experiment measured how frequency changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa frekvencia mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: The frequency of alternating current in Europe is 50 hertz.
Ultrasound has a frequency above 20 kHz and cannot be heard by the human ear.

definition: The smallest possible amount of a physical quantity.

examples.en: We studied the concept of quantum yesterday.
examples.sk: Včera sme študovali pojem kvantum.

examples.en: The experiment measured how quantum changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa kvantum mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: Max Planck introduced the concept of the quantum in 1900 to explain blackbody radiation.
A photon is the quantum of light and carries a specific amount of energy.

definition: A very small piece of matter.

examples.en: Understanding particle is essential.
examples.sk: Pochopenie pojmu častica je nevyhnutné.

examples.en: The experiment measured how particle changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa častica mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: The Higgs particle was experimentally confirmed at the CERN accelerator in 2012.
Alpha particles consist of two protons and two neutrons and are emitted during radioactive decay.

definition: The central part of an atom.

examples.en: Understanding nucleus is essential.
examples.sk: Pochopenie pojmu jadro je nevyhnutné.

examples.en: The experiment measured how nucleus changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa jadro mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: The diameter of an atomic nucleus is about 100,000 times smaller than that of the whole atom.
In nuclear fusion, two light nuclei merge into a heavier one and release large amounts of energy.

definition: Energy transmitted through waves or particles.

examples.en: This experiment shows how radiation works.
examples.sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje žiarenie.

examples.en: The experiment measured how radiation changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa žiarenie mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: X-ray radiation is used in medicine to make internal body structures visible.
Cosmic radiation constantly bombards the Earth's atmosphere, creating secondary particles.

definition: The study of heat, energy, and work.

examples.en: The thermodynamics is important in this field.
examples.sk: Termodynamika je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

examples.en: The experiment measured how thermodynamics changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa termodynamika mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: The second law of thermodynamics states that the entropy of a closed system never decreases.
Thermodynamics plays a central role in the design of heat engines such as steam turbines.

definition: The opposition to electric current or motion.

examples.en: This experiment shows how resistance works.
examples.sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje odpor.

examples.en: The experiment measured how resistance changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa odpor mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: Ohm's Law describes the relationship between voltage, current, and resistance in a circuit.
Superconductors have an electrical resistance of exactly zero at certain temperatures.

definition: A state in which opposing forces are balanced.

examples.en: The equilibrium is important in this field.
examples.sk: Rovnováha je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

examples.en: The experiment measured how equilibrium changes under different conditions.
examples.sk: Experiment meral, ako sa rovnováha mení za rôznych podmienok.

contextSentences.en: A body is in static equilibrium when the sum of all forces and torques acting on it is zero.
Thermal equilibrium is reached when two objects in contact reach the same temperature.
